title: Run GLiNER on a real T4 CUDA provider
summary: Install GLiNER dependencies, uninstall both onnxruntime distributions, then install only onnxruntime-gpu[cuda,cudnn]==1.26.0; prove a large MatMul and heavy GLiNER nodes in the ORT profile before timing.

data.required_proof: Synthetic MatMul CUDA node plus CUDA-assigned GLiNER MatMul/FusedMatMul nodes
